Fixes bats-lang/quire#1030

Head: d3979b0ae541e64fa8a08aa8e76ca677e1390845

Deviations: none

## Plan

Why: nothing checks the selection toolbar on the real Android WebView. The locked pwa (2026.11.5) writes `build_smoke_test_script_scaled_probes`, which reads probe files beside `smoke-test.sh`; quire supplies them.

Done-when of #1030, word for word:

> 1. The `android` job (`check.yml`) passes on the head, and its log shows the long press and one tap for each toolbar button with the result `true`, at 1.0 and at 2.0.
> 2. With the toolbar placement reverted (injected, log posted), the same job fails naming the missed buttons.

The change: `scripts/android/smoke-open.js`, `smoke-ready.js`, `smoke-select-point.js`, `smoke-tap-points.js`, `smoke-tap-result.js` (new), copied beside the Android project by a step of the `build` job of `check.yml`; the spec `e2e/android-smoke-probes.spec.js` (new, in the `reader` group) plays the probes in Chromium.

1. `timeout 598 python3 -I scripts/ci-groups.py members e2e reader | head -1` shows the new spec in the reader group.
2. `timeout 598 grep -n 'smoke-tap-points' .github/workflows/check.yml` shows the step that copies the probes beside the Android project.
3. `timeout 598 python3 -I tests/static/guidelines.py | tail -1` finds the guideline files clean.
4. CI pointer, the new spec: workflow `check.yml`, job `e2e`, step `Run e2e tests`; the matrix group `reader` prints lines with `android-smoke-probes.spec.js` (three tests: `the probes long press a word and tap every toolbar button, and the result is true`, `the result names a button that saw no click, and none that did`, `a tap that lands off the button is the one the result names`). The run of the head is found with `gh api "repos/bats-lang/quire/actions/runs?head_sha=<HEAD>"` (workflow `check.yml`); the e2e jobs start when the pull request is marked ready, since a draft runs plan and build only.
5. CI pointer, Done-when 1: workflow `check.yml`, job `android` (its called workflow's `smoke-test` job runs the emulator); the log holds no line starting `Long press:` or `Taps:` or `Ready:` or `Setup:` (the smoke script's failures, greppable) and the run of the head passes `android / smoke-test`; the probes' files are in the artifact (greppable: `smoke-tap-result.js` in the step `Verify PWA output` of job `build`). Found as in row 4.
6. CI pointer, Done-when 2: the toolbar placement of quire#1029 reverted on a commit of this branch, the log of the `android` job of `check.yml` posted on the pull request as a comment; it must fail with a line starting `Taps: font scale` naming the missed buttons (greppable: `Taps: font scale`). Not run yet: it follows the first green run of row 5.

## Execution

Files: `scripts/android/smoke-open.js`, `smoke-ready.js`, `smoke-select-point.js`, `smoke-tap-points.js`, `smoke-tap-result.js`, `e2e/android-smoke-probes.spec.js`, `tests/groups.json`, `.github/workflows/check.yml`. No `src/` change, so no `bootstrap/c`; `bats.lock` is unchanged (pwa 2026.11.5 already holds the scaled probes form).

Each probe is one JavaScript expression, as the smoke script runs them. The points are CSS pixels times `devicePixelRatio`. The tap probe records clicks on the toolbar's buttons with a capture listener and stops the app acting on them (except More), so the toolbar stays up for the next tap; it measures the row behind More by opening it for the measurement, and says `the-row-behind-More` as a missed button when that row had no buttons to measure. Offset of the web view in the window is assumed zero (not measured on a device: the emulator run is CI's).

Local runs: probes parse as expressions (`new Function`), `scripts/ci-groups.py` accepts the group; the e2e spec and the emulator run are CI's (disk allows no cold build).
